title: PAR-03/PAR-04 associative-action undecoded value variants fail closed
scope: Prevent associative-action value parameters from being reported complete when the parser does not decode their payload
Keep unverified value payload widths and class-specific DWG grammar unresolved
Add source-generated AC1024 parser controls without persistent drawing fixtures or CTest registration

odaDwgSpecification.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaDwgSpecification.search: Text extraction searched for associative-action/value-parameter terminology; the only associative match was the unrelated HATCH associative flag.
odaDwgSpecification.finding: The available ODA specification text does not provide the AcDbAssocAction value-parameter wire layout needed to assign payload widths.

localSource.finding: ObjectId, Int64, Point3d, Bool, Binary, and Invalid kinds had no payload decoder but returned true, permitting a typed prefix to be reported complete without consuming a value.

evidence.decision: Return false for all recognized-but-undecoded value kinds. Do not infer their payload widths from the generic group-code classifier or another consumer's grammar.

changes.production: src/drw_objects.cpp fails the typed action prefix for ObjectId, Int64, Point3d, Bool, Binary, and Invalid variants until their consumer-specific wire grammar is implemented.
generatedTests: tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp adds an in-memory AC1024 ACDBASSOCACTION frame builder and controls for group codes 350/ObjectId, 160/Int64, 10/Point3d, 290/Bool, 1004/Binary, and 700/Invalid.
Each unsupported vector independently checks the encoded group code and asserts parse refusal plus cleared typed state.
A supported Real group-code-40 control parses and reaches a following 3-bit body sentinel.
changes.baseline: Before the production change, five unsupported-kind controls reproduced false completion; the Int64 generated control was already rejected.

commands.result: PASS (all six unsupported variants refuse; Real control reaches sentinel)
PASS (only the unrelated HATCH associative flag matched)

assessment.confirmedLocalCorrection: The reader no longer treats an undecoded associative-action variant as a complete typed value.
unresolved: Exact AcDbAssocAction value-parameter DWG payload grammar and widths
Typed decoding and semantic interpretation for the six refused kinds
Independent native/platform and ACIS/ACDS semantic qualification
